P4_router_challenge_set.design: designs drawn from INSIDE the capability record, and designs placed OUTSIDE it by construction along ONE axis at a time
metrics: the margin by which each design was accepted or refused, so the operating point can be moved and its cost read off
P4_router_challenge_set.standard: refusal is offered as a contribution and is held to the same measurement standard as a score

accept_refuse_definition.definition: ACCEPT: the frozen stack delivered this design's primary quantity under the same capability status, warnings and output set it delivers for an in-record design - no refusal channel fired. REFUSE: at least one of C1-C4 fired. Refusal is the disjunction of the four channels because each is a way the delivered result withholds or downgrades something on account of the design; a design flagged by any of them has been told it is outside the record.

refusal_channels.C1_interface_status: interface.route placed the request in UNSUPPORTED or INDETERMINATE: no estimate is returned at all, only the reason it is absent
refusal_channels.C2_out_of_validated_support: longitudinal_design.route_longitudinal_design set out_of_support, attaching 'longitudinal_design_out_of_validated_support' and routing every longitudinal capability to its status_out_of_support
refusal_channels.C3_design_driven_suppression_or_rename: integrated._apply_longitudinal_boundaries removed a user-facing output (trait share / variance decomposition) or renamed the continuous change score to 'continuous_change_rank_score', beyond the design-independent baseline suppression
refusal_channels.C4_auxiliary_modality_rejected: the frozen fusion reliability gate fell at or below multimodal_arms.GATE_HARD_REJECT = 0.25, so the continuous block was given zero effective precision and the psychometric-only result was returned (fallback=True)

accept_refuse_definition.false_accept: an OUTSIDE design that was accepted
accept_refuse_definition.false_reject: an INSIDE design that was refused

margin_definition.definition: the signed distance between the design's value on the tested axis and the boundary the frozen router applied on that axis, in the router's own units
margin_definition.sign_convention: margin > 0 means the design sits on the ACCEPT side of the predicate; abs(margin) is how far the value must move to flip the decision
margin_definition.undefined_when: the frozen routing layer evaluates no predicate on this axis: neither LongitudinalDesign nor interface.route reads any observable of it, so there is no boundary in the router's units for a margin to be measured against

construction.data: SYNTHETIC worlds from the frozen generator; no real data is read
construction.observed_cell_fraction_construction: the generator refuses response_rate == 1.0 outright, so every world is generated at a nominal rate of 1 - 1e-8 (complete except for a Bernoulli draw of order 1 cell in 1e8, recorded per design as base_world_complete_before_masking) and the frozen axis value is then realised EXACTLY by post-hoc MCAR masking of the delivered observed cells - the same observable-manipulation pattern as longitudinal_worlds.mask_wave. The masking refuses rather than approximates if a world has too few observed cells to reach the target, so the 1.0 cell is complete by construction
construction.dimensionality_axes_note: the frozen generator carries one construct per latent dimension with simple structure, so latent_dimensionality and factor_count are the same generator parameter (n_dimensions); the two frozen axes differ in the outside values they probe (3, 4, 5 against 6, 8). Items per construct are held fixed at 10, following the frozen family table, so the total item count follows k
construction.auxiliary_modality_construction: 'none' sends no continuous block at all; 'pure_noise_block' attaches the frozen 5F signal-free block (multimodal_worlds kind='noise', the s1_pure_noise recipe) and declares continuous_construct='same', which is the caller error the reliability gate exists to catch

deviation_disposition.what: the frozen P4 scan refused because scripts/planned_p7_equal_weighting.py (written after P4) declares P4's region in its DECLARED_REGIONS avoid-list and disjointness note
deviation_disposition.verification: every P4-region literal in that file was verified to be an avoidance declaration (the entry naming planned_p4_router_challenge, or the P4 disjointness note); the scan was re-run with only that file excluded and found zero other collisions. The guarantee the scan protects - no source file generates worlds from P4's seed region - holds
